non_claims: the witnesses bound the slot, its in-image writer and the documented interface that fills it; they do not prove the body of the provider/application callback or the provider's own memory safety
the target set remains unbounded because the external ABI admits any conforming provider/application loader; a green element-7 is a contract bound, not a finite target set

the default-context arm of ossl_provider_up_ref_parent is the defensive prov == NULL branch of ossl_provider_libctx; admitting it proves only that it reads the same slot-18 object, not that a NULL prov is a valid caller input (the `# Safety` contract still requires a live prov)
